subject: Social Media
title: Variable Rewards
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Variable Rewards.

hook.text: A rat presses a lever and sometimes gets food, sometimes nothing. It presses obsessively. You do the same.

buildup.text: B.F. Skinner proved variable reinforcement is the most addictive reward schedule. Unpredictability hooks.

discovery.text: Social feeds are variable reward machines. Sometimes gold content, sometimes trash. You scroll to find out.

twist.text: If every scroll delivered great content, you'd be satisfied and stop. Bad content keeps you searching.

climax.text: Casinos use the same principle. The near-miss keeps you pulling. The mediocre post keeps you scrolling.

quiz.question: Who proved variable reinforcement is the most addictive reward schedule?
